{"consolidated_memory":"AREA: worker/queue/consumer.py — Message Redelivery in Consumer (Series of 4 Incidents)

The consumer experienced repeated message redelivery (same message id handled more than once) on four separate occasions between Jan-Jul 2026. All reproduced by killing the worker mid-batch and restarting it. All fixed in the same corner of worker/queue/consumer.py with context carrying over.

INCIDENT 1 [2026-01-27]
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root Cause: serialiser dropping unknown fields
- Fix: switched to strict schema rejecting unknown fields (PR #1549, branch fix/message-redelivery-1)
- Test Coverage: tests/worker/test_consumer.py
- Result: backlog cleared 32 minutes after deploy

INCIDENT 2 [2026-03-20]
- Trigger: accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Root Cause: schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum (PR #2026, branch fix/message-redelivery-2)
- Result: error rate dropped from 4.5% to under 3 per 10,000

INCIDENT 3 [2026-07-10]
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root Cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter (PR #4489, branch fix/message-redelivery-5)
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 83 days running

INCIDENT 4 [2026-07-11]
- Trigger: input list came in empty
- Root Cause: error swallowed by bare except
- Fix: narrowed the handler and let failure propagate (PR #5388, branch fix/message-redelivery-6)
- Result: reclaimed 54 GB of blob storage"}
